name: Warmuth's $C_5$ class
definition: Let the domain be the cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}/5\mathbb{Z}$.  A binary function belongs to $C_5$ precisely when, on some four consecutive cyclic positions, its values are $1,0,0,1$ in that order.  The value on the remaining position is unrestricted, so the class has ten functions.
comments: This is also called Warmuth's example.  It is a finite separation between unlabeled sample-compression size and VC dimension.
